text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout rc-2026-04-05-b deployed to canary-usw2. Post-deploy smoke prefill_agent_v1 started (250 samples). Observed ~1.5% heartbeat drop and intermittent p95 +200ms vs baseline. tagging #eng-releases :triage_lights:

nina: catching this. is this variant the new int8-pack build?

devin: yes, int8-pack-13b. quick trace peek shows occasional doubled tokens e.g. "hello\n\n" emitted by tokenizer on a subset of probes.

sre-maya: doubled tokens will misalign KV cache and spike tails. can we throttle synth to protect user lanes?

nina: lowering synth concurrency to 10rps via deploy-bot now.

deploy-bot: synth-fanout set=10 for canary-usw2. Starting 2m verification window. :ok_hand:

qa-lee: repro snippet: `seq 1 300 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/prefill -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` — p95 spikes in bursts when run under concurrent load.

devin: logs show tokenizer emitting U+FFFD replacement char for some UTF-8 sequences. those requests hit fallback kernels; cpu.user jumps and tail latency follows.

sre-maya: options: rollback canary, divert synth to float16 route, or keep synth low. recommend divert synth only so user traffic stays on int8 for more telemetry.

nina: prepared route change: synth-divert-0405 -> float16-13b. ready to apply. will also raise tracing to 100% for synth traffic.

deploy-bot: Applied route synth-divert-0405 -> float16-13b. Tracing sampling set to 100% for tag=canary-synth. Verification window resumed.

qa-lee: after diversion, synth p95 returned to baseline and sampled traces show no replacement chars. :white_check_mark:

devin: filing ticket INF-2026-210: int8 tokenizer emits replacement char on certain utf8 sequences causing kernel fallback and p95 spikes. assigning to devin. attaching traces and repro steps.

sre-maya: keep synth diverted for 24h and pause canary ramp until fix lands. add automatic guard: if p95 > baseline+100ms for 5m, auto-divert synth.

nina: guard rule created and runbook updated with these steps.

deploy-bot: Rollout state: paused. Guard rule added: synth-auto-divert on p95 regression.

qa-lee: note added to release draft: "Paused due to tokenizer edge-case under int8 pack; synthetic probes diverted while fix is applied."

devin: will work on tokenizer sanitizer and a debounce in fallback kernel path to avoid thrash. ETA initial PR today.

sre-maya: thanks team. closing loop for now — paused rollout, synth diverted, ticket INF-2026-210. :thumbsup:
